A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with complete, readable main text, figures, tables, equations, references, and Appendices A-G. Pages 2-34 have identical text and rendered appearance; page 1 differs only in author order and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v3 reports original robotic manipulation experiments, including scaling curves, four-task success rates, and model comparisons in Sections 4-6, with additional analyses and raw scores in Appendix G.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the task evaluations in Table 1, model comparisons in Table 2, and detailed experimental results in Appendix G.

M1.justification: The Diffusion Policy, DINOv2 encoder, temporal ensemble, and task-specific observation histories remain identical in Section 3 and Appendix C. The data collection strategy in Section 4.3 is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Pour Water, Mouse Arrangement, Fold Towels, and Unplug Charger, with identical object, environment, and joint generalization scenarios. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same training-from-scratch, frozen-encoder, LoRA, encoder-size, and U-Net-size comparisons. Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the paper.

E3.justification: Dataset subsampling, training budgets, model configurations, scoring and success criteria, and randomized evaluation procedures are identical in Sections 3-6 and Appendices C-E.

E4.justification: The model and training ablations in Section 6, metric comparison in Appendix E.1, and MSE scaling and approximately constant-demonstration analyses in Appendices G.1-G.2 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the 95% confidence intervals described in Section 4.1 and standard deviations across eight environments in Table 1. Trial counts and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout, including Appendix G. Table 1 retains success rates of 85.0%, 92.5%, 87.5%, and 90.0% for Pour Water, Mouse Arrangement, Fold Towels, and Unplug Charger, respectively.

T1.justification: The data-scaling formulation, optimality-gap definition, logarithmic power-law fitting, and qualification concerning irreducible error remain unchanged in Sections 3 and 4.2. No formal results or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same claims about approximate power-law generalization, the importance of environment and object diversity, and efficient data collection yielding roughly 90% task success.

C2.justification: Interpretations of diversity and model scaling, caveats about MSE and cross-batch comparisons, and limitations concerning single-task imitation learning, UMI, Diffusion Policy, and four-task coverage are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices B-F retain the same collection instructions, training details, Table 3 hyperparameters, evaluation workflow, and hardware specifications. The project link and statements about releasing code, data, and models are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B.1, and the bibliography are identical. No cited works or substantive positioning relative to prior research are added, removed, or revised.

P1.justification: The first two authors change order from Yingdong Hu followed by Fanqi Lin to Fanqi Lin followed by Yingdong Hu, retaining equal-contribution markers. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; body prose, headings, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-23 and Tables 1-12 retain identical displays, captions, formatting, and placement. Page organization is unchanged; the first-page differences are author and version-stamp text within the existing layout.

improvement.justification: The changes are confined to author ordering and the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific arguments, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and presentation structure remain identical, including the appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
